# Spec Delta — The `plainfiles` memory backend (slice C3)

> Ships `plainfiles` as the second `MEMORY_BACKEND` inhabitant: `save`/`search` write and read
> `.memory/records/*.jsonl` directly (zero binary deps), `share`/`pull` stay validation/plumbing only
> (records already ARE the store), the `save`/deferred-op asymmetry is explicit, and a two-direction
> round-trip against `engram` proves the durability claim. See design.md.

## REQ-C3-1: `plainfiles` is a real `MEMORY_BACKEND` (D1-D4)
`cli.mjs`'s `VALID_OPS` MUST gain `save` and `search`. With `MEMORY_BACKEND=plainfiles`, the existing
dynamic-import dispatch MUST route `save`, `search`, `share`, `pull`, `setup` to `backends/plainfiles.mjs`.
Every changed CLI string MUST carry en+es i18n entries.
Scenario: dispatch resolves `save`/`search` to plainfiles — MEMORY_BACKEND=plainfiles, `memory save`/
`memory search` route to plainfiles.mjs; save appends one validated record to `.memory/records/<yyyy-mm>.jsonl`.

## REQ-C3-2: `save` is scan-then-write, MEASURED (never-flagged) provenance (D1, Q2)
`plainfiles.save(title, content, {type, project, scope, topic})` runs `scanTextForSecrets` BEFORE any
write (fail-closed, mirrors `dualWriteRecords`, reuses secret-scrub.mjs). `actor`/`actorKind`/`ts` MUST be
MEASURED (getBranch/getHostname, like featureCheckpoint) and MUST NOT be accepted as flags/args — spoofable
provenance would undermine actor-check/L5. `ts` MUST use C2a's canonical UTC-seconds format, never `new Date()`.
Scenario: secret hit rejects the write fail-closed, nothing written.
Scenario: successful save records measured actor/actorKind/ts (not caller input), then rebuildIndex().

## REQ-C3-3: `search` is a zero-binary Node scan (D2)
Reads via `store.mjs#readRecordObservations`, filters in Node, no required external binary. `rg` used
only if present (`which rg`), never in package.json/install-tools.sh.
Scenario: search works with no `rg` installed (pure-Node fallback).
Scenario: `rg` used only as accelerant when present, results equivalent either way.

## REQ-C3-4: `share`/`pull` are validation/plumbing only; no auto-discard (D3, Q3)
`share()` = self-check `rebuildIndex()` only, no data movement. `pull()` = `git pull` + `rebuildIndex()`,
records-only, NO engram-import step. Dirty `.memory/` at pull time delegates to git and reports honestly —
NO auto-discard (pullMemory()'s manifest-dirty-discard skeleton is engram-materialization-specific and
does not apply; git is plainfiles' only writer).
Scenario: share revalidates index, no data movement.
Scenario: pull with dirty tree reports honestly, no silent discard, reindex only after clean pull.

## REQ-C3-5: the save/deferred-op asymmetry is explicit, never cryptic (Q1)
`save` under `MEMORY_BACKEND=engram` errors explicitly, pointing to engram's native `mem_save` (no second
CLI-mediated save door for engram). Under plainfiles, `index()`/`featureCheckpoint()`/`featureResume()`
each return an explicit "unsupported" error, never a silent no-op.
Scenario: engram save errors pointing to native mem_save, nothing written.
Scenario: each plainfiles deferral (index/feature-checkpoint/feature-resume) exits non-zero, named error.

## REQ-C3-6: the two-direction round-trip is the CP-C3 evidence (D6)
Hermetic, seam-injected suite proves BOTH directions record-level-equal for N records covering every
RECORD_TYPES member + a supersedes chain: engram→plainfiles via `dualWriteRecords(tmpRoot,
{_readObservations: fixture})` then `plainfiles.search()`; plainfiles→engram via `plainfiles.save()` then
`importMemory({_engramSave: captureCalls})`. No live engram/git in `npm test`.
Scenario: engram→plainfiles round-trips with record-level equality, no live process spawned.
Scenario: plainfiles→engram round-trips with record-level equality, no live process spawned.
Scenario: durability executable — bare git clone + grep on `.memory/records/*.jsonl` answers a decision
question with no engram/rg dependency.

## Out of scope
C4 chunk-migration completion (separate follow-up issue), MCP over `.memory/`, engram symlink removal
(ADR-0002), record format changes (C0/C1 territory), plainfiles-native index/featureCheckpoint/
featureResume (deferred to unsupported error per REQ-C3-5).

## Gate
`npm test`, `brain:repo:check`, `brain:nav` green, no new `brain:audit` failure. Docs in English (ADR-0009).
